title: Brand AI-Readiness Audit Report
description: The report emitted by the audit-orchestrator entrypoint. The required properties reproduce the contest's minimum shape exactly; everything else is an addition.

evidence.description: Must carry a concrete observed value, and a URL must appear either here or in affected_urls. Enforced by the advisory-review evidence-sufficiency gate; a finding that satisfies neither is dropped.

mechanism.description: Why the fix works, expressed in pipeline terms.

verification.description: How to confirm the fix landed.

layer.description: Which pipeline gate the finding belongs to.

claim_level.description: 1 direct observation, 2 descriptive contrast, 3 mechanism interpretation. Level 4 causal prescriptions are never emitted as findings; they appear only in proactive_recommendations.

consequences.description: Downstream symptoms merged into this root cause by the advisory layer.

scope.description: What was actually audited, so the reader can calibrate the findings.

rehomed_from.description: Present only when the supplied URL redirected permanently to a different registrable domain and the audit was re-anchored to it. The same fact is repeated in limitations[], because a re-anchored scope changes what the report is about.

scores.description: Site-level measurements backing the findings and driving the charts.

evidence_genres.description: Coverage of the genres whose influence uplift arXiv:2604.25707 §8.2 measures: definition, comparison, howto, numeric, code, qa_format. These are the only genres with an effect size, so they are the only ones plotted against the uplift bars.

survey_genres.description: Coverage of the extractable-fact genres arXiv:2607.14035 §7.2 names and §7.5 Table 4 grades Moderate: price, dated. Deliberately kept out of evidence_genres — a coverage grade and a measured effect size are different orders of claim and must not share a chart.

proactive_recommendations.description: Improvements where no defect was detected. The only place claim-level-4 material may appear, and only as a labelled hypothesis.

advisory.description: Audit trail from the in-loop critic: what it removed, demoted or merged, and why.

limitations.description: What this audit could not see. Stated so findings are not over-read.
